odc_type: Incorrect state management in object comparison
observation_summary: The ShapeUtilities.equal method returns true for non-identical GeneralPath objects, causing assertion failures in unit tests.
reasoning_summary: The bug report and test failure indicate that the ShapeUtilities.equal(GeneralPath, GeneralPath) method fails to correctly distinguish between different paths. The root cause is that the implementation uses the same PathIterator instance for both paths being compared. Because PathIterator is stateful, iterating through one path advances the iterator for both, leading to incorrect equality results where the method returns true for any two non-null GeneralPath instances that share the same winding rule, regardless of their actual geometric content.
